required_admission: exact experimental file/member hashes and paper/version correspondence
matched labels, same physical construct/biosample/replicates and target units
reference, coordinate, strand, phase and indel verification
frozen input windows and endpoint annotation/readout profiles
exact served model/weight identity and genomic/assay/evaluation/calibration exposure audit

split.unit: connected component of same gene/locus, overlapping genomic model windows, matched alleles/pair windows/replicates; synthetic parent-construct family
split.canonical_key: compact JSON array of sorted unique component member identifiers; stable accession/build/chromosome/half-open-window/parent-construct/assay identities; no labels or predicted scores
split.hash: SHA256(UTF8(salt + newline + canonical_key)); unsigned big-endian digest modulo 20
split.actual_membership_status: NOT_CREATED; freeze member hashes and counts before fitting or test predictions
split.low_component_count_policy: stop and preregister a revised protocol before evaluation; no test-informed relaxation

module1.primary_reporter_transport_metric: paired difference in Spearman correlation of combined effects: combination vs additive
secondary_metrics: interaction sign agreement on experimentally resolved effects
module1.matched_endpoint_only_metric: signed combined-effect MAE after fixed physical unit conversion

module2.expression_only_baseline: scale REF total abundance by predicted expression change; keep REF relative isoform/junction usage
module2.expanded_readout: predeclared normalized splice/junction information or positional RNA coverage; no learned weighting
module2.primary_splicing_metric: MAE of signed delta PSI in fraction units (each PSI in [0,1], delta PSI in [-1,1]), only after exact target correspondence
module2.primary_apa_metric: MAE of signed delta proximal usage in fraction units (each usage in [0,1], delta usage in [-1,1]), only after exact target correspondence
secondary_metrics: cleavage-distribution distance only on matched normalized support
module2.PAS: derived RNA-seq coverage; not independent direct track

uncertainty.resampling_unit: locus/component including all matched records and replicates
uncertainty.interval: nominal 95 percent percentile bootstrap on paired metric difference; coverage not established for these datasets

fitting.current_plan: NONE; unfitted predeclared comparison only subject to applicable permitted analysis terms

reproductions_excluded_from_test: official hypothetical cis TERT chr5:1295113G>A + chr5:1295135G>A liver UBERON:0002107
scope_limits: reporter transport is not calibrated endogenous tissue expression
constructed cis is not observed personal phase
no clinical, causal-intervention, ancestry or G6 claim
no actual experimental file download, inference, fitting or benchmark executed
